card.name: Inside new brand drug names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of newer brand names, such as the B in INBRIJA, the IB in HIBSAGO, or the K in MEKTOVI, when the name is partly spelled out in label text. Also seen on LAB in the class name LABA.
